'''Dan Waier''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Milwaukee tournament]] on 18 November 2000 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB Matching Pilots]], according to Bryan Prittie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1466">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-18-hegans-field-of-dreams-milwaukee-wid1466/ hegans-field-of-dreams-milwaukee-wi], DeckTech (Bryan "DMX" Prittie, 18 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-18-hegans-field-of-dreams-milwaukee-wid1466/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
